style: Single full-bleed wide 16:9 traditional Chinese ink-and-watercolor illustration for a chapter book for seven-year-olds. Textured paper, warm jade and gold, friendly faces, no lettering, no panels, no harm or gore.

scenes.title: 一、殘妖逃遁竄深淵，大聖緊追不放鬆
scenes.scene: Wukong and chef Paoding talk beside a wooden kitchen table; a plain cooking knife rests flat beside cabbage and a white bowl. Paoding recounts his years of learning.

scenes.title: 二、西海龍宮求相助，摩昂太子引龍兵
scenes.scene: In the heavenly kitchen, Wukong invites apron-clad Paoding along, one palm open; Paoding tilts his head thoughtfully beside the stove.

scenes.title: 三、波濤翻湧分巨浪，水中合圍困殘魔
scenes.scene: Paoding and Wukong look at a scroll picturing several different cattle breeds, with pale cloud silhouettes of cattle in the background. No writing.

scenes.title: 四、辟塵辟寒難招架，束手就擒現真身
scenes.scene: Wukong and Paoding quietly meet a human military governor over a simple map in the lantern-lit Jinping office. Clouds outside and no weapons.

scenes.title: 五、割取神角獻天庭，保得人間四季和
scenes.scene: Wukong and a bipedal armored rhinoceros king agree to a contest with open palms on opposite sides of a grassy clearing, distant cattle and two other rhino kings behind.

scenes.title: 六、金平府民喜迎聖，焚香跪拜謝神恩
scenes.scene: Exactly three clothed rhino kings with gold, ice-blue and jade armor confer beneath a pine at the rocky cave. No monkey or other foreground figure.

scenes.title: 七、點亮千家長明燈，師徒整裝再登程
scenes.scene: Paoding watches from a rocky ledge as a huge herd of varied cattle emerges from a cave in colorful swirls of dust, no weapons or injury.

scenes.title: 一、翻越千山涉萬水，漸近靈山聖境來
scenes.scene: Small monkey doubles in red scarves scramble onto low white clouds as a distant herd rushes across a broad valley, no contact or injury.

scenes.title: 二、天竺國界花如錦，城池巍峨氣象新
scenes.scene: Wukong looks down from a high ledge into a gourd-shaped green valley, surveying its winding river, steep cliff walls and a distant dust cloud. Emphasize landscape.

scenes.title: 三、古道深處林蔭翳，路遇名寺布金林
scenes.scene: Wukong redirects his tiny monkey doubles over a rocky pass; a cloud of dust and a few rolling boulders suggest the passage closing, everyone safely distant.

scenes.title: 四、落日餘暉照古剎，暮鼓晨鐘洗俗心
scenes.scene: Wide view of steep gourd-shaped valley with fiery orange light and black smoke rising far below; Wukong watches from a safe foreground ridge. No figures amid fire, no visible suffering.

scenes.title: 五、方丈合掌迎遠客，禪房奉茶話桑麻
scenes.scene: Wukong points with one finger as an armored rhino spirit freezes in a ring of golden magic. Two other rhino kings pause in astonishment. No injury.

scenes.title: 六、古林深處清泉咽，忽聞低聲啼哭哀
scenes.scene: Paoding appears from a cloud while Wukong's golden spell freezes a fully intact armored rhino spirit in the background. Paoding focuses on its armor, no blade contact, no harm.

scenes.title: 七、大聖留神側耳聽，疑是人間有不平
scenes.scene: Four pilgrims reunited and preparing to depart Jinping. Chef Paoding in gray apron waves beside a festive table with white bowls. White horse waits quietly.

scenes.title: 一、荒院深處鎖重門，悲啼切切動人心
scenes.scene: The four pilgrims reach a forest monastery under ancient trees. A middle-aged gray-robed adult monk greets Tang at the gate. White horse and travel bundles.

scenes.title: 二、長老詢問知隱祕，竟是天竺真公主
scenes.scene: Elder abbot tells Tang about a temple's origins; a soft separate misty memory shows a golden-brick garden and two dignified human figures, no words.

scenes.title: 三、妖風刮來假金鳳，鳩佔鵲巢奪宮闈
scenes.scene: In a mossy rear temple garden, an elderly abbot and Tang in red pause by a weathered wooden door when they hear quiet crying; gentle concern.

scenes.title: 四、投江遇救淪古剎，裝瘋賣傻保清白
scenes.scene: Elder abbot explains a fully clothed adult princess was brought to his temple; a soft memory-like cloud beyond the doorway shows the princess in blue silk stepping down unharmed from a gust. No other princess.

scenes.title: 五、唐僧垂淚憐弱女，行者拍胸攬救局
scenes.scene: Four pilgrims approach the imposing gates of Tianzhu capital and a colorful market, streets populated by distant cheerful vendors. No bridal display yet.

scenes.title: 六、進城倒換關文去，巧遇繡球彩樓高
scenes.scene: Tang in red and his three companions look up at a high ornate bridal balcony with fluttering silk and a crowd below. Princess not yet throwing.

scenes.title: 七、飛彩流丹天竺京，一拋正中唐僧冠
scenes.scene: A fully clothed adult princess in embroidered silk at the top of a balcony tosses a bright embroidered globe with tassels toward a surprised Tang in gold monk crown below. No injury.

scenes.title: 一、宮闕巍峨笙歌奏，國王喜納大唐僧
scenes.scene: Tang holds a red embroidered bridal ball in bewilderment as human palace attendants invite him toward the palace; Wukong in red scarf discreetly whispers advice at the edge of the crowd.

scenes.title: 二、大聖暗展火眼睇，原是月宮玉兔精
scenes.scene: The Tianzhu king listens on his throne as the elaborately dressed adult false princess gestures toward Tang in red patchwork kasaya. All human in appearance; no Wukong or rabbit yet.

scenes.title: 三、行者金箍棒陡起，妖女拔釵現凶相
scenes.scene: The three disciples arrive together in Tianzhu court before the king, joining Tang: red-scarfed monkey, blue-robed pig and green-robed bearded Sha. Human officials look on in surprise.

scenes.title: 四、翻雲覆雨出宮門，直打九霄毛骨寒
scenes.scene: Wukong introduces himself before the curious Tianzhu king as Tang sits nearby, Bajie and Sha stand respectfully. Quiet court audience, no combat.

scenes.title: 五、玉杵翻飛戰神鐵，妖力難支欲逃亡
scenes.scene: Tang in red monk robes respectfully explains his vow to the concerned king across a low court table. Pig Bajie and bearded Sha listen, human palace setting.

scenes.title: 六、太陰星君乘彩霧，嫦娥仙子下廣寒
scenes.scene: Outside the palace on pastel clouds, Wukong uses red staff to guard against a fully clothed adult false princess with a jade medicine pestle. Keep her in opaque lavender traveling robes. No injuries.

scenes.title: 七、頑兔伏罪歸天闕，真假分明救佳人
scenes.scene: Near the Western Heavenly Gate Wukong follows a thin escaping streak of gold light from a vanished foe; pink-snouted Bajie listens to him at the edge of a small cloud. No goddess or rabbit yet.

scenes.title: 一、靈山福地霞光繞，十萬八千終到頭
scenes.scene: Moon goddess Chang'e, fully clothed in flowing pale robes and decorated with osmanthus flowers, descends on pastel clouds and raises one open hand to ask Wukong to pause. The false princess in opaque lavender robes stands safely apart.

scenes.title: 二、凌雲渡口滾滾浪，獨木危橋不敢行
scenes.scene: Chang'e gently cradles a white jade rabbit on a patch of moonlit cloud while Wukong lowers his staff. Rabbit unharmed, soft osmanthus, no other characters.

scenes.title: 三、接引佛祖撐小艇，無底扁舟立碧波
scenes.scene: The real ADULT princess embraces the king and queen in a bright Tianzhu palace as smiling blue-clothed Bajie and Wukong stand at a distance; relieved family reunion.

scenes.title: 四、師徒四人登寶船，浮尸順水逝無蹤
scenes.scene: Four pilgrims and white horse arrive in a luminous mountain landscape with streams and colored peaks, approaching the sacred mountain on foot. No temple audience yet.

scenes.title: 五、脫卻凡胎化金身，心輕體健上靈峰
scenes.scene: Gold-robed immortal welcomes Tang outside a small mountain sanctuary and gestures toward a winding uphill footpath. Other disciples and the horse wait respectfully behind.

scenes.title: 六、雷音古剎祥光聚，八百羅漢列兩旁
scenes.scene: Tang and companions pause before a wide rushing river and a narrow log bridge, as a tiny boat with a serene ferryman approaches from mist. No one on the bridge yet.

scenes.title: 七、朝禮如來大殿上，萬劫磨難終成空
scenes.scene: A small magical ferry glides on wide sparkling rapids, carrying all four friends and the boatman. A luminous red reflection on the water symbolizes Tang leaving old burdens behind, no body in river.

scenes.title: 一、藏經閣內取經卷，尊者索取人事金
scenes.scene: Four pilgrims climb the last steps to Great Thunder Temple atop Lingshan. Two kindly armored guardian figures welcome them. White horse and golden sunrise.

scenes.title: 二、長老兩袖皆清風，換得白本無一言
scenes.scene: Two Buddhist guardians show Tang and his three companions into a vast library of neatly stacked bundles of sutras. One guardian extends an open hand and Tang listens in surprise.

scenes.title: 三、燃燈古佛知機變，化現白雄抓碎包
scenes.scene: Tang and companions leave the library respectfully with cloth-wrapped bundles stacked on a white horse and carried bundles, a distant elder Buddha looks down from an upper window. No pages floating yet.

scenes.title: 四、白紙漫天方驚覺，大聖怒告佛祖前
scenes.scene: Blank cream sheets flutter in the air above a mountain path as bearded Sha holds up one sheet toward an astonished Tang. Wukong and pig Bajie keep the horse steady. No writing.

scenes.title: 五、如來笑言經不賤，傳道豈能空手還
scenes.scene: Back in Great Thunder Temple, the Buddha in warm gold explains patiently from a lotus throne. Tang and the three disciples listen, Wukong holding a blank sheet of paper.

scenes.title: 六、獻出隨身紫金缽，換取真言五千卷
scenes.scene: Tang offers a distinctive purple-gold alms bowl in both hands to two Buddhist librarians beside tidy shelf rows, cloth-wrapped scriptures and warmly lit wooden walls.

scenes.title: 七、如獲至寶背行囊，功德圓滿啟歸程
scenes.scene: Four pilgrims and white horse ride east on a colorful cloud, carrying securely tied scripture bundles. Lingshan temple far behind, morning sky, hopeful.

scenes.title: 一、駕雲騰空返大唐，八十一難差一劫
scenes.scene: Four pilgrims and their white horse sit and stand safely on a broad pebbled riverbank, looking around in surprise with the wrapped scriptures beside them. Late light, no boat yet.

scenes.title: 二、通天河底老黿怒，落水濕經晾石臺
scenes.scene: A huge friendly ancient turtle ferries four pilgrims, one white horse and tied scripture bundles on its broad shell. It turns its head to ask Tang a question. River surface calm, no one falling yet.

scenes.title: 三、殘經補全天道合，師徒喜見長安城
scenes.scene: Four pilgrims spread damp pale scripture leaves across flat sunlit rocks near a broad river. White horse nearby and turtle swimming far away. Everyone safe, no lettering.

scenes.title: 四、太宗率眾迎御弟，大雁塔上誦梵音
scenes.scene: Emperor Taizong warmly welcomes Tang and his three disciples at Chang'an palace, allowing attendants to receive their wrapped scriptures. Beautiful distant Tang dynasty tiled roofs and no text.

scenes.title: 五、金光萬道騰空起，重回靈山受封賞
scenes.scene: On the Great Thunder Temple floor Tang and Monkey King receive blessings from Buddha on a lotus throne, with Bajie and Sha standing alongside. Soft gold rays, respectful joy.

scenes.title: 六、唐僧旃檀悟空佛，八戒羅漢沙僧身
scenes.scene: White horse gently emerges from a sacred pool as a graceful golden dragon surrounded by pearly mist. Tang, Monkey King, Bajie and Sha look on from dry banks in wonder.

scenes.title: 七、白龍化作八寶馬，西遊傳奇萬古傳
scenes.scene: Monkey King gently touches his BARE forehead where the circlet has disappeared, visibly no headband or crown, red scarf, broad relieved smile. Tang in red and the other friends by him in warm gold light.

scenes.title: 一、話筒前的一百三十八集，長達數年的陪伴
scenes.scene: Symbolic closing chapter art: a cozy open illustrated storybook and a simple microphone under warm lantern light, tiny unlettered painted silhouettes of four travelers beside a white horse along a winding path on the pages.

scenes.title: 二、西遊記是一座寶庫，每個人都能照見自己
scenes.scene: Historical Xuanzang, an adult Tang-dynasty Chinese Buddhist monk in simple ochre travel robes, walks at a small horse's side across a vast Gobi landscape. No mythical figures, soft bands of sand and sky.

scenes.title: 三、孫悟空的勇氣，唐僧的執著與善良
scenes.scene: Historical adult Xuanzang stands by a small horse beside an empty soft water pouch on desert sand, looking determinedly at the distant trail. Quiet heroism, no death or distress, no mythic figures.

scenes.title: 四、豬八戒的真性情，沙和尚的踏實可靠
scenes.scene: A present-day adult storyteller with backpack walks an ancient winding desert trail at sunrise, contemplating Xuanzang; a faint warm distant silhouette of monk and horse in the landscape as a memory, no words.

scenes.title: 五、生活就像取經路，我們每個人都在打怪
scenes.scene: The four friends share a quiet travel moment in a golden landscape: Tang helps a tired traveler, Wukong in red scarf watches thoughtfully, pig Bajie and bearded Sha nearby. Reflective storybook ending.

scenes.title: 六、只要心中有夢想，就沒有克服不了的困難
scenes.scene: Pig Bajie in a plain blue tunic and steady bearded Sha in moss-green help each other carry the travel bundles on a wooded path, Tang and Wukong softly visible ahead. A moment of teamwork.

scenes.title: 七、感謝寶貝的聆聽，願你成為自己的齊天大聖
scenes.scene: Peaceful closing illustration from behind: Tang, Monkey King without headband, Bajie, Sha and white horse walking side by side into the sunrise, long winding path, distant meadow and sky. Friendship, gentle warmth, no lettering.
